title: Triangle closure of the bounded constructible étale-origin class on the pro-étale site with finite coefficients
statement:
Let $X$ be any scheme and $B$ a finite commutative ring with the discrete topology. On the small pro-étale and étale sites of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-size-convention] use the coefficient ring sheaves $B_{X,\mathrm{pro\acute et}}=(U\mapsto\operatorname{Cont}(\pi_0(|U|),B))^\#$ and $B_{X,\mathrm{\acute et}}$, the unbounded derived categories $D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},B)$ and $D(X_{\mathrm{\acute et}},B)$, the comparison $
u_X:X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}	o X_{\mathrm{\acute et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] with its termwise exact derived inverse image $
u_X^*:D(X_{\mathrm{\acute et}},B)	o D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},B)$, and the strictly full subcategory $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},B)$ of objects $N$ admitting an isomorphism $
u_X^*A\xrightarrow{\sim}N$ with $A$ a bounded constructible étale complex, all exactly as defined in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]; bounded constructible étale complexes are those of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] (cohomology vanishing outside a finite interval, every cohomology sheaf constructible with respect to a finite partition of $X$ into locally closed constructible subschemes). Write $O_B(N)$ for $N\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},B)$. Then $O_B(0)$ holds; $O_B$ is invariant under isomorphisms; $O_B(N[r])\Longleftrightarrow O_B(N)$ for every integer $r$; and for every distinguished triangle $N_1	o N_2	o N_3	o N_1[1]$ of $D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},B)$ [def-weil-triangulated-category], any two of $O_B(N_1),O_B(N_2),O_B(N_3)$ imply the third. In particular $D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},B)$ is a strictly full triangulated subcategory of $D(X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},B)$, although the inverse image $
u_X^*$ is not assumed full on unbounded objects. No Noetherian, quasi-compactness, dimension, finite-type or invertibility hypothesis on $X$ is imposed; the zero ring and the empty scheme are allowed.

proof.text: Let $P(N)$ mean that the intrinsic pro-étale cohomology sheaves of $N$ are constructible and vanish outside some finite interval. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin] with the given $X,B$: its source uses exactly our globally stratified étale constructibility predicate and its inverse image is the specified ring-sheaf inverse image. The equivalence says precisely $O_B(N)\Longleftrightarrow P(N)$. This uses the bounded comparison only; it asserts no fullness on all unbounded objects.

source.place: Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived, statement and first paragraph of proof; Tag 09B5, lemma-constructible-serre

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-proetale-dbc-triangulated] to $Y=X$ and $\Lambda=B$. Its predicate is $P$. It gives $P(0)$, invariance under isomorphisms, $P(N[r])\Longleftrightarrow P(N)$ for every $r\in\mathbf Z$, and closure when the first and third terms of a distinguished triangle satisfy $P$. Substitute the equivalence from step 1 to obtain the corresponding assertions for $O_B$.

source.place: Tag 09AL, lemma-compare-constructible-derived, statement and first paragraph of proof; Tag 09B5, lemma-constructible-serre

proof.text: For the triangle $N_1\to N_2\to N_3\to N_1[1]$, if $O_B(N_1),O_B(N_2)$ hold, rotate once by TR2 to $N_2\to N_3\to N_1[1]\to N_2[1]$; its outer terms satisfy $O_B$ by shift stability, so step 2 gives $O_B(N_3)$. If $O_B(N_2),O_B(N_3)$ hold, rotate twice to $N_3\to N_1[1]\to N_2[1]\to N_3[1]$; step 2 gives $O_B(N_1[1])$, hence $O_B(N_1)$. Together with the outer-term case this gives all three implications. The defined essential image is strictly full, and these closure assertions make it triangulated.

theorem isBoundedConstructibleFiniteCoefficient_isTriangulated (T : Scheme.{u})
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    [TopologicalSpace Λ] [DiscreteTopology Λ] :
    (isBoundedConstructibleFiniteCoefficient T Λ).IsTriangulated :=
lean.note: Exact existing theorem for the recorded isBoundedConstructibleFiniteCoefficient predicate and FiniteCoefficientDerivedCategory, including arbitrary schemes, finite commutative discrete rings, the zero ring and the empty scheme. ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated encodes zero, all integer shifts and extension closure; its rotation instances give all three triangle implications. The essential-image predicate is already IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms by Mathlib ObjectProperty.map, so strict fullness and shift equivalence require no additional hypothesis. The theorem uses bounded-below full faithfulness, not unbounded fullness.
